title: Workflow capabilities
description: What the workflows can do for the repository, and who can set them going. Deploying is not among them since deploy.yml was removed on 2026-11-23.

entities.name: Continuous integration
entities.description: Every pull request is checked: its .dev files validated, each game it changes tested and built, and its database changes held for an acknowledgement. Nothing is deployed; games are deployed by hand.
entities.responsibility: Test and build each game a change touches, and refuse database changes nobody has applied. Deploying each game is done by hand with npm run deploy, outside the workflows.
access: Any pull request runs CI and the Database migration check; the workflows check nobody.
main takes only pull requests, because it requires the Database migration check (AGENTS.md); a merge to main starts no workflow.
Deploying is outside the workflows: the owner, or an agent the owner asks, runs npm run deploy in a game's folder with a Cloudflare API token for the account.

relatedViews.relationship: Migrating a database is enforced by its gate.
The workflows and scripts that make it up.
